designPrinciple: Do not fill a 6-item axis bank merely for numerical symmetry. If redundant or conceptually impure, retire an item and version the instrument; no automatic substitution into existing Q/S/T/C.
validationChecklist: Choose operational construct for A/C/D before adoption
Verify alternative items are not reformulations of an existing item
Verify response target and scenario applicability across target groups
Probe high-high and low-low counterexamples; avoid forced bipolarity
Ensure zero participant collection until G1 and applicable D42 approvals
Any revised question ID or scoring semantics needs new version and owner approval
